card: Restructures unit tests for ParseHDKeypath in bip32_tests into a table-driven test that verifies exact parsed numeric derivation paths and round-trip formatting. Existing tests only checked the boolean return value, allowing an implementation that cleared or corrupted the output vector to pass tests unnoticed. This change strictly modifies test code to ensure keypath parsing accuracy without altering runtime behavior.
changed_since_previous: Dropped the codebase-wide scripted rename of ParseHDKeypath to ParseHDKeypathLegacy, restricting the PR strictly to unit test coverage in bip32_tests.cpp.
evidence: PR description: 'This can be demonstrated by breaking the implementation by adding a keypath.clear(); statement just before the final return true;. With this obviously broken implementation the tests pass.'
problem: The unit test for ParseHDKeypath previously asserted only the boolean return status for most test inputs. A broken parser implementation returning true while clearing or corrupting the output vector would still pass unit tests.

risk.why: Touches only unit test assertions in bip32_tests; a mistake would cause false-positive test failures.

summary: Restructures the parse_hd_keypath unit test in bip32_tests into a table-driven test and verifies the parsed numeric keypath vector against expected values rather than only asserting boolean success. It also adds round-trip formatting checks with FormatHDKeypath and tests additional edge cases.
